fee_notes: Royalty is 20% of gross member enrollment fees, but 10% for certain programs (children's programs, special events, Elevate and personal touch programs). Class owner franchise minimum is currently $250/month (may increase to $1,000/month); business franchise minimum is currently $500/month (may increase to $1,500/month). Advertising fund not yet established as of issuance date; when established, up to 2% of gross member enrollment with minimum $50/month. Technology fee is currently $45/month (up to $500/month). Additional fees include: Associate Fee ($160/year lump sum or $16/month); Performance Royalties (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, GMR — varies by member count); Late Fee $100 ($20 for monthly fees); Non-Compliance Fee up to $500/violation; Local Livestream Fee up to $50/month (not yet established); Transfer Fee $100; Renewal/Status Change Fee up to $100 (not yet established).
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Fee/ Royalties: 20% of gross member enrollment (10% for certain programs). Class owner franchise minimum currently $250.00 per month (could increase to $1,000.00 per month); business franchise minimum currently $500.00 per month (could increase to $1,500.00 per month). Upon processing and upon filing of monthly report. See Note 1.
Advertising Contribution: When established, up to 2% of gross member enrollment, no less than $50.00 per month. Same as Continuing Fee/Royalties. See Note 9.
Technology Fee: Up to $500.00 per month; $45.00 as of issuance date of Disclosure Document. Same as Continuing Fee/Royalties. See Note 11.
